payload.title: RET-DEF-ROOT-WIRE: retarget root pkg/wire Definitions construction from service/ to wire/
payload.ask: After Automations DEL cleared the Automations-leased root-wire hold, and after INV-DEF-TOPLEVEL through DEL-DEF Factory completion, retarget root pkg/wire Factory Definitions construction so process composition imports factory_definitions/wire only—not the transitional factory_definitions/service compile shim—while leaving residual DEF fold/delete work to the live DEL-DEF-RESIDUAL lane.
systemShapeRequirements: Retarget root construction call sites in pkg/wire to factory_definitions/wire (NewService / published wire constructors) instead of factory_definitions/service.New / AttachEffectiveCatalog
Keep factory_definitions/service as an owner-local transitional shim until DEL-DEF-RESIDUAL deletes it; do not delete service/ or other residual DEF top-level packages in this packet
Do not invent new pkg/root or pkg/wire Factory Definitions helper APIs beyond the retarget; prefer existing factory_definitions/wire.NewService
Do not fold residual DEF packages, reopen HTTP/CLI/MCP DEF adapters, or invent FUN-definitions in this packet
Flip factory_definitions root_wire_hold_test.go so it asserts pkg/wire no longer imports factory_definitions/service (retire PostAutoDELDefinitionsWireRetargetFollowUp hold)
testCoverageRequirements: Update pkg/services/factory_definitions/root_wire_hold_test.go (and any sibling boundary tests that encode the Automations-leased residual import) so the hold becomes a post-retarget forbid of factory_definitions/service from pkg/wire
Reuse existing wire/root composition and Factory Definitions construction tests; add only missing proofs that root construction compiles and constructs through factory_definitions/wire
Do not invent a new peer/root test subsystem or substitute import-scanner-only proof for a green construction build
acceptanceCriteria: pkg/wire (factory_definition_service_provider.go, cli_commands.go, profiles.go, session_runtime_providers.go) no longer imports github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/services/factory_definitions/service (behavioral)

Root process composition constructs Factory Definitions through factory_definitions/wire.NewService (or equivalent published wire constructor) and still returns the singular factorydefinitions.Service peer surface (behavioral)
root_wire_hold_test.go (or successor) fails if pkg/wire reintroduces the transitional service import
Typecheck, lint, and required CI are terminal green; PR merged before Factory completion
outOfScope: Deleting factory_definitions/service or other residual DEF top-level packages (DEL-DEF-RESIDUAL)
antiPatterns: Leaving pkg/wire on factory_definitions/service because 'DEL will delete it later'
Deleting service/ under this lease and racing live DEL-DEF-RESIDUAL
Inventing a new pkg/wire FactoryDefinitionsRootFromEdges helper instead of using factory_definitions/wire.NewService
Treating package-shape inventory alone as completion without flipping the root_wire_hold_test residual import assertion
Touching live DEL-SET / DEL-REC / WRK-CONTRACT / FUN-work implementation leases beyond unavoidable shared baseline/Wire rebase
currentProgress: DEL-AUTO is Factory-terminal; Automations root is wire/internal/transports; the Automations-leased root-wire hold is cleared.

INV-DEF-TOPLEVEL, IMP-DEF-02R/03R/05R/06R, CLN-DEF-CONTRACTS, CUT-DEF-SES, CUT-DEF-RUN, BOOT-DEF, CLN-DEF-FOLD-TOPLEVEL, and DEL-DEF are Factory-terminal (DEL-DEF #1603 / 1d4e73fbf; idea/plan/task/review complete).

changedPathLease: pkg/wire/** only for unavoidable Definitions construction binding fallout from the retarget
pkg/services/factory_definitions/wire/** only if thin published constructor/adapter adjustments are required for root composition
exclude deleting factory_definitions/service or other residual DEF top-level packages
exclude live DEL-SET / DEL-REC / WRK-CONTRACT / FUN-work / DEL-DEF-RESIDUAL deletion leases except shared-file rebase
payload.requestedOutcome: Retarget root pkg/wire Factory Definitions construction from the transitional factory_definitions/service compile shim to factory_definitions/wire only at the named call sites (factory_definition_service_provider.go, cli_commands.go, profiles.go, session_runtime_providers.go), prefer factory_definitions/wire.NewService for inert root construction, flip root_wire_hold_test.go so pkg/wire is forbidden from importing factory_definitions/service, and leave service/ deletion plus residual DEF fold debt to live DEL-DEF-RESIDUAL.
